item.text:
The project uses the built-in **`@shadcn`** registry. The `registries` field in [components.json](~/work/jf-work/agent-finds-a-component-1795637863169/app/components.json) is empty, so there are no custom registries configured.

Searching `@shadcn` for “date picker” returned three examples:

| Registry item | Use |
|---|---|
| `@shadcn/date-picker-demo` | Pick a single date |
| `@shadcn/date-picker-with-range` | Pick a start and end date |
| `@shadcn/date-picker-with-presets` | Pick a date using presets |

The examples combine `Popover` and `Calendar`. [shadcn/ui Date Picker docs](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/radix/date-picker)
